name: Annual money review
audience: Households doing a once-a-year review of their own records.
summary: Look back at twelve months of surplus and set a single figure for next year.
description: Each month has income, costs, and a surplus formula. The review shows the total, the average, the best month, and the worst month. Next year's monthly target is something you type, and the sheet shows the gap against the average.
benefits: See which month actually carried the year
Use your own monthly figures, not a generic average
Set next year's target beside the evidence
compatibility: Microsoft Excel for Microsoft 365 or Excel 2021 and later
Formulas also open in Google Sheets; confirm PMT, FV, and NPER after import
PDF guide opens in any PDF reader
DOCX guide opens in Microsoft Word or Google Docs
disclaimer: This workbook organises figures you type in. It is not financial, credit, insurance, or tax advice. Rates, fees, and laws change. A qualified adviser should review decisions that affect debt, tax, medical cover, or retirement.
